purpose: research obligation register; not a submission readiness certificate

obligations.statement: Prove correspondence between the explicit verifier-based machine classes and conventional P and NP.
For a search-compression approach, construct and prove a general-problem reduction, including input-size and output-size bounds and both directions of correctness.
Prove that constructing the protocol operator, initial seed and target does not assume the original decision answer and has the required resource bound.
Implement the protocol decision procedure in the stated Turing-machine model and prove its running-time bound as a function of encoded input length.
A complete-problem reduction to a polynomial-time decision procedure would support equality, whereas the existing prize proposition states inequality; neither conclusion is established.
To prove the defined inequality, exhibit a certificate-polynomial language and exclude every deterministic polynomial-time machine, rather than only explicit orbit-cover enumeration.
